value.rationale: Exact first-extinction shells for all multiplicities of two types of petals refine the pre-existing generic convergence exponent on a natural minimally aperiodic directed network. The formula gives a sharp-six characterization and a nontrivial limiting first-hit law concentrated equally on times two and three, independent of the count of shorter petals. This information is not implied by knowing the sole two fixed points.
